mismatches: not checkable: 151/39/50 pairs removed (pre-filter counts absent from pairs file)
method_findings: MAE vs logMSE gap is the long-gap effect: gap>=12h pairs (32/47/37, ~10%) carry 89/98/98% of M's log squared error; clipping yhat at the data 1st pct (diagnostic) moves logMSE skill vs B0 from -0.85/-9.9/-11.1 to +0.58/+0.68/+0.61, MAE skill unchanged (0.395->0.399). MedAE agrees with MAE. Coolant/oil logMSE vs B0 upper bound <0 (stronger than the pack case).

Not only floor: a pure exponential at the coolant slope with the real selection leaves <=13% of pairs at >=12h, yet 47 survive and only 39 removed overall, so retention exceeds the line (shape misfit). Floor and misfit confounded. B0 is a weak reference at long gaps.
Pack gap<1h: B2==B0 in every fold (43% of y exactly 0). S3 real but marginal (upper -0.002; 29/30 seeds <0) and merely restates failed S1; not an independent finding.

S3 fragile: oil ge1 upper -0.009 becomes +0.001 under 5-day moving-block bootstrap. S3 one-sided: coolant/oil gap<1h M beats bins (+0.10, CI>0), no statement; pooled mixes opposite-sign strata. No multiplicity adjustment.
Sentence 'negative R2 is not no decay' holds only for gap>=1h (MAE/MedAE lower bounds >0); it does not show model adequacy.
leakage_findings: Contiguous arrival-day folds, 9 boundaries, 4-5 pairs/fit share a drive across a boundary; negligible. Fixed-fold bootstrap adequate: k=5/20, random-day, LODO, block bootstrap change nothing except oil ge1 S3.
independence: Reused only M429_pairs.json and spec; own code in analyses/M430_audit/ (audit_m430.py, extras.py, robust.py, leak.py, floor_sim.py).
